items.title: OPI Abstraction v0.1.0: Linux Foundation Ends DPU Lock-In
items.summary:
* **标题**：Linux Foundation 发布 OPI Abstraction v0.1.0，终结 DPU 厂商锁定
* **核心摘要**：Linux Foundation 联合 Arm、NVIDIA、Intel 等 26 家核心厂商，推出基于 gRPC 和 Protocol Buffers 的 OPI Abstraction v0.1.0。该框架提供硬件无关的 API 层，旨在解决 DPU 市场长期存在的厂商 SDK 锁定问题，确保工作负载可在不同硬件间无缝迁移。同时，首个生产级蓝图“Kubernetes 网络功能卸载”已上线，将网络功能卸载至 DPU 硬件，释放 CPU 资源，标志着 DPU 生态从封闭走向标准化。

items.title: social media rabbit holes, clusters, and the relative mixing times of random walks
items.summary:
* **标题**：Twitter 社群结构解析：右翼阵营的紧密聚类与算法推荐机制
* **核心摘要**：基于 2012 年数据构建的 Twitter 领域共现矩阵分析显示，右翼内容社群呈现高度紧密的聚类特征，而左翼社群则结构松散。这种聚类差异直接影响了推荐系统的随机游走混合时间：右翼用户因推荐路径收敛快，易陷入信息茧房；左翼用户因推荐路径发散，信息获取呈现高方差。该发现揭示了 Twitter 并非单一公共广场，而是由不同紧密度的“高中食堂”式社群构成的复杂网络。

items.title: Mesa 26.2: NVK Gets Mesh Shaders and OpenCL 3.1 Lands on Five Backends
items.summary:
* **标题**：Mesa 26.2 发布：NVK 支持 Mesh Shaders 与 OpenCL 3.1 覆盖五后端
* **核心摘要**：Mesa 26.2.0 正式引入 NVK 对 Mesh Shaders 的原生支持，并实现 OpenCL 3.1 在 AMD、Intel、Apple Silicon 及 CPU 等五类后端的全覆盖。NVK 支持从 Kepler 至 Blackwell 系列显卡，实验性 DLSS 性能约为专有驱动 50%。同时，修复了 VA-API 中的未边界堆内存写入漏洞，建议生产环境用户尽快升级至 26.2.1 版本。

items.title: REpsych: Psychological warfare in reverse engineering
items.summary:
* **标题**：逆向工程新范式：REpsych 以控制流图生成程序
* **核心摘要**：REpsych 工具集通过程序控制流图（CFG）将源图像转化为可执行程序，实现逆向工程中的“心理战”概念。该工具兼容 IDA Pro 等主流反汇编工具，支持将像素映射为基本块，为图像生成与逆向分析提供了新的技术路径。

items.title: Assembly Hall of Shame: Racing to the bottom of CPU performance
items.summary:
* **标题**：CPU 性能“耻辱殿堂”：通过 PCIe 总线饱和攻击实现单指令延迟极限测试
* **核心摘要**：该项目旨在寻找单指令性能的绝对下限，通过利用 PCIe 总线高延迟特性，利用多核并发饱和总线带宽，将 `fxrstor64` 指令延迟推高至 1.98 亿亿个周期。这种“反向优化”策略揭示了现代处理器架构中，指令延迟不仅取决于微代码路径，更受制于外部总线资源的竞争与拥塞。

items.title: Claude Security Plugin: Scan Code for Vulnerabilities in Beta
items.summary:
* **标题**：Claude 安全插件 Beta 发布：多智能体架构重构静态分析
* **核心摘要**：Anthropic 于 7 月 22 日推出 Claude Security 插件，无需额外配置即可在终端内运行。该工具采用六阶段多智能体流水线，通过威胁建模与三重验证机制，专门针对 SAST 工具无法识别的跨服务逻辑漏洞。虽然单次全量扫描成本高达 75 万美元，但其语义推理能力有效补充了传统规则引擎的盲区。

items.title: Am I the problem? Interviewing another team to find out
items.summary:
* **标题**：技术团队冲突的根源：是流程问题还是沟通缺失？
* **核心摘要**：作者通过采访 ngrok 公司的基础设施团队，发现技术分歧（如 Argo Rollouts 与自研工具的选型）往往源于缺乏共识。采访对象指出，通过跨团队沟通、尊重同事自主权并共同完善方案，能有效减少冲突并提升执行意愿。作者反思自身在 Cisco 时期因缺乏同理心导致的团队摩擦，最终通过坦诚沟通修复了与前任同事的关系。

items.title: Cloudflare Workers AI and AI Gateway Are Now One Control Plane
items.summary:
* **标题**：Cloudflare 统一 AI 控制平面：Workers AI 与 AI Gateway 合并，实现单一 API 与计费
* **核心摘要**：Cloudflare 将 Workers AI 与 AI Gateway 整合为单一控制平面，消除多系统维护痛点。开发者仅需一行代码即可启用全链路可观测性，并支持通过同一绑定调用外部模型（如 OpenAI、Anthropic）及 Cloudflare 原生模型。统一计费体系不仅简化了成本追踪，还通过提升速率限制激励迁移，同时引入模型优先路由机制，实现基于模型而非提供商的自动分发。

items.title: Ancient Library – 1,060 Greek/Latin texts, click any word to parse it
items.summary:
* **标题**：古希腊罗马语料库全解析，一键获取词源与形态
* **核心摘要**：该数字平台收录 1060 部古典文献，涵盖拉丁语与希腊语。用户可直接点击任意词汇，即时检索其词根、词形变化及权威词典释义，为语言研究与文本分析提供高效工具。

items.title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731
items.summary:
* **标题**：DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 在 ARC-AGI 基准测试中实现极致性价比
* **核心摘要**：DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 模型在 ARC-AGI-1 和 ARC-AGI-2 半私有基准测试中分别取得 89.0% 和 61.4% 的得分。该模型在保持高性能的同时，任务成本极低，ARC-AGI-1 仅需 0.02 美元/任务，ARC-AGI-2 仅需 0.04 美元/任务。

items.title: PS3 emulation is fast on ARM now
items.summary:
* **标题**：ARM 架构下 PS3 模拟器性能显著提升
* **核心摘要**：PS3 模拟器在 ARM 架构上的运行速度已得到优化，相关技术进展引发社区关注。

items.title: Open Source Models Beat GPT-5.6 Sol at Retrieval — 100x Cheaper
items.summary:
* **标题**：开源模型在检索任务中超越 GPT-5.6 Sol，成本降低 100 倍
* **核心摘要**：Castform 与 Neon 联合发布基准测试，证实经强化学习微调的 40 亿参数开源模型在检索精度上对标 GPT-5.6 Sol，同时实现 100 倍成本优势。通过自动化将 Postgres 数据库转化为训练集，该方案无需专业 ML 团队即可构建生产级 RAG 系统，将日均百万级查询的推理成本从 3000 美元降至 30 美元。

items.title: Can Machine Learning Unmask REIT Bond and Equity Markets? My Take on a New Landmark Study
items.summary:
* **Title:** Machine Learning Reveals Dynamics in the REIT Market: New Research Analyzes Equity and Debt Pricing Mechanisms

* **Summary:** A 2026 doctoral thesis by Dr. Hendrick Janne analyzes REIT equity returns and debt risk premiums using machine learning and explainable AI, covering the period from 1991 to 2023. The research indicates that company-specific variables drive 60% to 70% of returns as markets mature, and that bond investors do indeed price location risk. Furthermore, the study reveals a non-linear relationship with geographical diversification; increasing management complexity beyond an optimal concentration level (HHI 0.25) leads to higher risk premiums.

items.title: Exploring the Laravel AI SDK: RAG, Agents, and Effective Production Patterns
items.summary:
* **Title:** Laravel AI SDK Production Best Practices: RAG and Agent Architecture
* **Summary:** The Laravel AI SDK simplifies AI integration through a unified interface, enabling the creation of agents with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and autonomous task execution capabilities. For production deployments, key considerations include thorough testing coverage, performance monitoring, and a user feedback loop to ensure accuracy and stability in real-time interactions.

items.title: Veri Biliminde Bulut Bilişim Dönüşümü: Data Science Bootcamp Sürecinde Büyük Veri, Modelleme ve…
items.summary:
* **Title:** From On-Premise to Cloud-Native Architecture: Scalability and Cost Optimization in Practical Big Data Science

* **Summary:** Addressing memory overflow and hardware bottlenecks in large-scale data processing, this article explores using cloud platforms like AWS and Azure to achieve dynamic resource scaling and GPU acceleration. The practical examples cover the entire process, from data cleaning and feature engineering to model training, utilizing automated shutdown scripts and Spot Instances to reduce costs by 70%-80%, alongside the implementation of MLOps frameworks for model deployment and version management.

items.title: Position One Is No Longer the Finish Line. Being Cited Is the Next Contest.
items.summary:
* **Title:** The Age of AI Summaries: The Top of Search Results Are No Longer the Finish Line – Citations Are the New Battleground

* **Summary:** As AI summaries are taking over search results, the average click-through rate for websites on the first page of search results has decreased by approximately 58%. Data shows that brands cited in AI summaries have a click-through rate approximately 120% higher than those not cited within their category. This indicates that SEO competition has shifted from simply competing for ranking positions to a dual strategy of optimizing both rankings and gaining citations.

items.title: The Circular Fashion Deadline: Five Capabilities Brands Need Now
items.summary:
* **Title:** New EU Regulations Force the Fashion Industry: Five Key Capabilities for a Circular Economy Transition

* **Summary:** Starting July 19, 2026, the EU will prohibit the destruction of unsold clothing and will implement a textile digital product passport. Brands must urgently develop five key capabilities: one, adopt fiber-level recycling technologies (such as Infinited Fiber, Worn Again) to address regulatory requirements and reduce reliance on raw materials; two, build a secondary market through a “Resale-as-a-Service” (RaaS) model to expand revenue across the entire product lifecycle; three, establish an efficient reverse logistics and repair system, similar to the Patagonia model, to address inventory challenges; four, strengthen supply chain transparency and compliance to meet EU mandatory disclosure requirements; and five, leverage the circular economy to generate new revenue streams and reduce dependence on virgin materials.

items.title: How to Rank in ChatGPT and Google AI Search in 2026: The Complete Guide for Businesses
items.summary:
* **Title:** 2026 Corporate SEO: A Guide to Transitioning from Traditional Search to AI-Driven Search

* **Summary:** As user behavior shifts from traditional search engines to AI assistants like ChatGPT, simply optimizing traditional SEO will no longer be sufficient to maintain competitiveness. Businesses need to build high-quality, structured content and establish authority within specific vertical domains to achieve rankings in AI-generated search. By improving content depth, update frequency, and website performance, combined with professional IT solutions, companies can ensure visibility and growth within the AI search ecosystem.

items.title: Why I Wrote a Pop Song to Launch My New WordPress Plugin — and What GEO Has to Do With It
items.summary:
* **Title:** AISA Plugin Released: A Pop Song Explores the Convergence of SEO and GEO

* **Summary:** A developer has created a pop song titled “AISA” to illustrate the merging of SEO and GEO. The article highlights how generative search (GEO) is leading to a deeper integration between traditional SEO and generative engine optimization. The AISA plugin offers one-click bulk optimization and structured data enhancement, aiming to help websites be more easily understood and discovered within AI-driven search, emphasizing “being seen” as the core objective of digital content creation.

items.title: The Illusion of Memory: Why Agentic AI is Actually a Context Management Problem
items.summary:
* **Title:** Agentic AI’s Hallucinations: The Core Issue is Context Management Engineering

* **Summary:** Large language models themselves lack memory and state, making it impossible to maintain continuity in long-term tasks. The core of building intelligent systems isn’t about fine-tuning model weights, but rather about implementing a dynamic state serialization, on-demand retrieval of memory, tool output budget control, and context eviction mechanisms through an external engineering layer. The “agency” of the intelligent system is, in fact, a closed-loop context management system built around a state-less prediction engine.

items.title: Why Zapier Is Overrated for Business Process Automation (And the $358/Month Lesson That Changed How…
items.summary:
* **Title:** Zapier Automation Costs: The Hidden Expenses Behind $358/Month
* **Summary:** The article highlights that platforms like Zapier, which are suitable for short-term testing, can lead to exponentially increasing costs when used for high-volume operations due to their task-based pricing model. A comparison shows that a $400/month platform subscription is significantly more expensive than a $12/month VPS self-hosted solution. Furthermore, the lack of version control and maintainability within no-code workflows can result in significant rebuild costs when core logic becomes complex, often exceeding the cost of the platform subscription. The article recommends migrating long-running core business logic to a code-based implementation.

items.title: Jumping onto the Right Side of the AI Divide
items.summary:
* **Title:** Bridging the AI Gap: Moving from Passive Consumption to Proactive Integration – Four Key Steps

* **Summary:** The AI gap – the difference in how individuals and organizations utilize AI – is reshaping the workplace. To overcome this gap, companies don’t need technical expertise; instead, the focus should be on shifting AI from a passive conversation tool to an active workflow engine. This can be achieved through: building structured prompting capabilities, strengthening human judgment and strategy, creating AI-assisted portfolios, and implementing secure and compliant AI usage.

items.title: MHA vs. MQA vs. GQA vs. MLA: Attention Efficiency
items.summary:
* **Title:** Evolution of Attention Mechanism Efficiency: From MHA to MLA’s KV Cache Compression
* **Summary:** The industry is evolving from standard Multi-Head Attention (MHA) to approaches like Multi-Query (MQA), Grouped-Query (GQA), and Multi-Layer Attention (MLA) to address memory bandwidth bottlenecks in the inference stage. GQA currently represents the mainstream solution, balancing quality and compression. MLA, on the other hand, achieves extreme memory optimization through architectural compression, but requires higher training costs. As context window sizes increase and concurrency demands grow, attention mechanism memory efficiency is becoming a key factor in determining the size of deployed models.

items.title: Labor Cost Percentage Benchmarks for Multi-Location Restaurant Groups
items.summary:
* **Title:** Benchmarking Labor Costs for Multi-Store Restaurant Groups: Moving from Single Percentage Metrics to SPLH and Prime Cost for Efficiency Management
* **Summary:** In multi-store restaurant operations, a single labor cost percentage metric is easily influenced by sales fluctuations, leading to flawed operational decisions. The article points out that relying on general benchmarks (such as 24%-28% for fast food) is not suitable for different business models, and excessive reductions in labor can negatively impact the customer experience. It suggests using composite metrics like Sales Per Labor Hour (SPLH) and Prime Cost (food + labor cost ratio), combined with dynamic scheduling and automated alerts, to maximize labor efficiency across multiple stores while maintaining service quality.

items.title: What District Managers Actually Need from Restaurant Reporting (and Why Dashboards Fall Short)
items.summary:
* **Title:** Why Traditional BI Dashboards Are Failing: The Three Key Capabilities Regional Managers Actually Need
* **Core Summary:** Regional managers, who frequently visit between 10 and 20 stores daily, are struggling with information overload and outdated reports from traditional BI tools. These tools provide raw data lacking context and actionable solutions, preventing managers from identifying key issues *before* store visits. The article argues that regional managers need automation for ranking anomalies, root cause analysis, and specific checklists, shifting store visits from “data filtering” to “growth coaching,” and enabling immediate decision-making through natural language summaries.

items.title: The Courage of Building Even Before You’re Ready
items.summary:
* **Title:** The Age of AI: Imperfect Builders Are the Reality

* **Summary:** In the rapidly evolving field of AI, many developers are participating with incomplete concepts and rough prototypes, rather than finished products. This honesty – approaching with “unfinished ideas and rudimentary prototypes” – challenges the illusion of perfection, revealing the inherent chaos and uncertainty of the building process. The article emphasizes that true courage lies in showcasing imperfection, and highlights that “learning AI” and “building with AI” are distinct activities. Maintaining adaptability through a continuous cycle of “learning – experimenting – building – observing – improving” is key to navigating technological change.

items.title: Why Data Preparation Matters More Than Machine Learning — Especially in the Cloud
items.summary:
* **Title:** Cloud-Native Data Engineering: The Key Bottleneck Before Algorithm Selection Lies in Data Quality and Problem Definition
* **Summary:** The article points out that in cloud-based data science projects, building machine learning models is not the primary task, but rather relies on clear problem definition, reliable data preparation, and a strong understanding of the business. The author emphasizes the CRISP-DM framework, highlighting that fundamental work such as data cleaning, handling missing values, and consistency checks directly determine the upper limit of models. Blindly pursuing algorithm precision often leads to wasted resources.

items.title: How to Read Daypart Variance in Multi-Unit Restaurants (Comp Sales Are Down but You Don’t Know Why)
items.summary:
**Title:** Why is overall revenue declining across multiple stores in a chain, despite consistent operations?

**Core Summary:** When overall revenue declines across multiple stores, simply focusing on daily total revenue will not reveal the underlying issue. By breaking down sales data by time (morning, noon, evening, night), it’s possible to identify structural differences in customer flow and average order value. Recommendations include analyzing average order value, turnover rate, menu combinations, and staff scheduling to quickly pinpoint time-based operational weaknesses and avoid making arbitrary adjustments.

items.title: pgrust Hits 300x Faster Postgres Analytics — Here’s How
items.summary:
* **标题**：pgrust 以 300 倍性能突破 Postgres 分析瓶颈：批处理、算子融合与 SIMD 的复合效应
* **核心摘要**：pgrust 通过批处理、算子融合及 SIMD 指令集优化，将 5 亿行聚合查询耗时从 1.3 秒压缩至 135 毫秒，性能超越 Postgres 300 倍、ClickHouse 18.5%。尽管扩展生态尚未完全验证，其 46,000+ 回归测试通过率与 4,000+ 星数已确立其作为高性能分析引擎的技术地位。

items.title: Software Understanding in the Sciences is Really Uneven
items.summary:
* **标题**：科学家编程能力断层：从黑体树构建到性能优化的实践反思
* **核心摘要**：在构建天体物理模拟后处理工具时，发现学生代码存在大量低效实现，如重复读取文件、嵌套字典手动模拟树结构等。通过引入性能分析工具，团队重构了核心逻辑，将 Jupyter Notebook 转为脚本并优化数据结构。作者指出，科学家缺乏系统性的软件工程训练，导致对 Python 内存模型、数据结构和调试器使用等基础概念理解不足，建议引入类似“缺失学期”的专项培训。

items.title: 80,000 Tech Jobs Gone in 2026 — AI Is Behind Half
items.summary:
* **标题**：2026 年 8 万科技岗位流失，AI 与自动化成裁员核心驱动力
* **核心摘要**：2026 年 7 月美国就业报告显示，全球科技行业已裁员约 8 万人，其中近半数明确归因于 AI 或自动化。尽管存在“AI 甩锅”争议，但实际裁员规模已达 4 万人。受冲击最严重的岗位集中在初级开发、QA 工程及重复性任务领域，而具备复杂推理与领域专家能力的角色则相对稳健。数据显示，掌握 AI 技能的开发者薪资溢价达 43%，行业正加速向 AI 工程、云安全及平台架构等方向迁移。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.9】ChaosDeputy72/Windows11ProActivate
items.summary:
* **标题**：Windows 11 Pro 激活工具 ChaosDeputy72 发布，基于官方 KMS 机制实现一键永久激活
* **核心摘要**：ChaosDeputy72 项目发布 Windows 11 Pro 激活工具，采用官方 KMS 机制与公共服务器，无需破解。该工具通过 PowerShell 脚本实现一键激活，支持 Pro、Workstations、Education 及 Enterprise 版本，并附带自动清理旧密钥与进度反馈功能。

items.title: AI & The University
items.summary:
* **标题**：AI 重塑高校编程教育，代码生成技术引发行业信任危机
* **核心摘要**：过去一年，基于 AI 的编程实践迅速普及，深刻改变了开发者的工作模式。这种技术变革动摇了开发者对传统计算机编程的信仰基础，迫使教育界与行业重新审视编程教育的核心目标与技能培养方向。

items.title: Cloudflare Kitesurf: A Rust Browser Built for AI Agents
items.summary:
* **标题**：Cloudflare 推出 Kitesurf：专为 AI 代理设计的 Rust 浏览器引擎
* **核心摘要**：Cloudflare 发布 Kitesurf 浏览器引擎，采用 Rust 与 WebAssembly 架构，完全运行于 Cloudflare Workers 的 V8 隔离环境中。该引擎专为 AI 代理场景优化，内存占用仅为 Chromium 的 1/7，HTML 提取效率提升 3.1-3.8 倍。尽管在绝对时间上略慢于 Chromium，但在批量截图与结构化数据提取场景下，其资源成本优势显著。

items.title: How a device finds encrypted DNS by itself
items.summary:
* **标题**：DDR 协议实现设备自主发现加密 DNS 端点
* **核心摘要**：DDR（Designated Resolver Discovery）机制允许设备通过 DNS 查询 `_dns.resolver.arpa` 自动获取加密 DNS 服务（DoH/DoT/DoQ）的端点信息。该方案无需手动配置，支持已加密连接的设备无缝升级，并能为仅支持 IP 配置的终端设备提供加密接入能力。然而，若设备初始连接为明文，升级过程仍可能暴露于网络监听，因此直接配置加密 DNS 仍是更优解。

items.title: Almost consensus: ABD and the edges of quorum replication
items.summary:
* **标题**：ABD 算法与准序复制的边界：为何它无法解决共识问题
* **核心摘要**：文章通过 Python 代码演示了基于准序复制的 ABD 算法实现，并深入剖析了该算法在分布式注册表中的核心机制。作者指出 ABD 虽能容忍节点不可用，但其线性化特性使其无法解决真正的共识问题，也无法替代 Compare-and-Swap 操作，从而厘清了 ABD 与 Paxos、Raft 等共识算法的本质边界。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.3】daved-lab2001o0/adopt-me-roblox-script
items.summary:
* **标题**：Roblox Adopt Me 自动化脚本 v5.1.2 发布，集成自动采集、宠物生成与房屋复制功能
* **核心摘要**：该脚本提供 Roblox Adopt Me 游戏内的自动化采集、宠物生成及房屋复制等核心功能，支持 Windows/macOS/Linux/iOS/Android 多平台。相比同类工具，其具备稳定的自动采集机制、完整的宠物生成系统及极简 GUI 界面，并采用自动更新与优化逻辑以降低检测风险。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.7】xinwithyu/dwell-on-something
items.summary:
* **标题**：dwell 项目：让 AI 像“住”在用户身边，而非工具
* **核心摘要**：dwell 是一个开源的 AI 陪伴项目，旨在通过功能文档与前端界面，构建一个“住”在用户身边的 AI 实体。项目包含心跳、推送、日记、健康等 15 个具体功能模块，并详细记录了 AI 的交互逻辑与数据架构。其核心挑战在于平衡“何时行动”与“何时静默”，强调 AI 应像真人一样具备生活节奏，而非随叫随到的工具。项目采用非商业许可，鼓励社区共建与分享。

items.title: Claude Code Self-Hosted Runner: Keep Your Code Off Anthropic’s Cloud
items.summary:
* **标题**：Claude Code 自托管运行器：企业级代码隔离与合规新范式
* **核心摘要**：Anthropic 于 2026 年 8 月 6 日开放自托管环境 Beta 测试，允许 Team 及 Enterprise 用户将代码仓库、构建产物及密钥保留在本地基础设施。该功能通过 `claude self-hosted-runner` 命令部署长生命周期进程，实现代码与模型推理的分离：代码运行于本地，而对话流仍通过 Anthropic API 进行。支持固定与按需两种运行模式，满足对数据合规、内部网络访问及零信任架构有严格要求的企业需求。

items.title: What happens if an entire class of workers loses faith in their careers
items.summary:
* **标题**：知识工作者职业信仰危机：AI 冲击下的存在主义焦虑
* **核心摘要**：随着人工智能对知识工作的潜在威胁，高收入技术从业者及资深专业人士正陷入前所未有的职业虚无感。这种焦虑超越了传统的经济波动，表现为对知识工作意义的根本性质疑，促使许多专业人士转向陶艺、编织等模拟爱好寻求精神慰藉。文章探讨了若整个知识工作者阶层丧失职业信心，社会与产业将面临何种深层震荡。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.5】alfiecg24/Titan
items.summary:
* **标题**：Titan 项目：基于 Coruna 链路的 iOS 16-17.4 微内核逃逸与 PPL/SPTM 绕过
* **核心摘要**：Titan 利用 AGX 协处理器 ROP 链与微休眠上下文篡改，成功绕过 iOS 16.1-17.4 的 PPL 与 SPTM 保护机制。该漏洞利用基于 Coruna 链路的改进，通过伪造页表映射 XNU 内核页表，实现了对 AGX 协处理器的完全控制。项目依赖 `kalloc` 与 `kmap` 等二次原语，并针对 iOS 18.1 及 17.4 的补丁进行了适配，旨在为 Dopamine 3.0+ 环境提供稳定的越狱基础。

items.title: Managing AI Coding Costs at Scale
items.summary:
* **标题**：破解 AI 编程成本指数增长困局：Databricks 开源基础设施实践
* **核心摘要**：Databricks 团队联合 Stripe、Coinbase 等头部企业，总结了一套在规模化部署 AI 编程工具时控制成本的核心策略。通过聚焦“效率前沿”而非单纯追求“智能前沿”，利用元工具（Meta-harness）和 AI 网关（AI Gateway）实现模型灵活路由与成本透明化。文章指出，通过消除冗余推理调用、优化缓存写入及建立统一成本观测能力，企业可在保持低摩擦访问体验的同时，将单位用户成本控制在固定范围内，从而解决 AI 生产力提升与成本失控并存的悖论。

items.title: What is an AI Assistant?
items.summary:
* **标题**：企业级 AI 助手选型指南：从通用对话到自主代理的演进路径
* **核心摘要**：AI 助手通过语言模型、数据检索与推理能力，将自然语言请求转化为 SQL 生成、仪表盘构建及自动化工作流。市场价值预计 2035 年达 1141 亿美元，但选型需区分六类场景：语音助手、客服聊天机器人、通用 AI 助手、垂直领域助手、数据开发助手及自主代理。企业应依据数据集成深度、治理合规性及任务复杂度，选择能嵌入数据目录与自主执行的多步任务工具，以缩短从提问到行动的时间，实现决策支持自服务化。

items.title: Prime Agent: The Open-Source AI Coding Agent That Learns
items.summary:
* **标题**：Prime Agent 开源：首个具备自我迭代能力的 AI 编程代理
* **核心摘要**：Prime Agent 基于递归语言模型（RLM）架构，通过“持续执行器”实现跨会话的指令记忆与状态持久化。其核心突破在于将上下文作为可编程变量，利用子代理并行协作，有效规避长任务中的信息压缩损耗。尽管在 ARC-AGI-3 基准测试中得分略高于人类专家水平，但其自我改进机制的合规性尚存争议。

items.title: Making Postgres 300x faster for analytics: batching, operator fusion, and SIMD
items.summary:
* **Title:** pgrust Rebuilt Postgres Query Engine, Achieving 300x Improvement in Analytical Workload Performance

* **Summary:** pgrust has rebuilt its query engine, resulting in a 300x performance improvement for analytical database workloads compared to Postgres.  Testing using the Clickbench benchmark showed that pgrust outperformed Clickhouse. The key optimizations include eliminating Postgres’s legacy locking mechanisms and storage format parsing overhead, as well as adjusting CPU and memory bandwidth utilization to suit modern in-memory computing.

items.title: From constraint models to playable puzzle games
items.summary:
* **标题**：约束模型驱动：从论文到九款可玩谜题游戏
* **核心摘要**：作者基于 43 万 + 数独实例库，利用 Gecode 与 MiniZinc 构建出 Sudoku、Nonogram 等九款可玩游戏。核心机制在于利用约束传播与唯一性检测生成谜题，通过离线生成与静态分发实现“从约束模型到可玩游戏”的转化。

items.title: Show HN: textlog – A quiet, text-only microblogging platform, open-source, no JS
items.summary:
* **Title:** textlog: Open-Source Microblog – Minimalist Text Socializing, Without JavaScript

* **Summary:** textlog is an open-source microblog platform focused on text logging. It achieves a minimalist approach through a 280-character limit and a JavaScript-free architecture, aiming to reduce barriers to writing and emphasize content quality over social engagement. The platform utilizes a decentralized design, supporting data export and deletion, and is intended for developers and those seeking a distraction-free, focused writing environment.

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.10】Kaan-Kross/4R022-StreamDeck-2.0V
items.summary:
* **标题**：4R022 StreamDeck 2.0V：无硬件依赖的流媒体键盘软件方案
* **核心摘要**：该项目为物理流媒体键盘提供免费的软件替代方案，通过 Python 实现基于事件驱动的键盘热键管理。支持多显示器布局、自动下载网站 Favicon 及自定义快捷键，采用 JSON 配置与事件监听机制，无需额外硬件即可模拟实体设备交互体验。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.8】miqdadbadjuber/anti-slop
items.summary:
* **标题**：AI 生成代码“垃圾”治理：36 条强制规则与交付门禁
* **核心摘要**：该项目旨在通过 `ANTISLOP.md` 文件，为 AI 编程代理建立一套防生成通用 UI 垃圾的过滤机制。其核心包含 36 条强制性设计规则、五项工艺标准及交付门禁，采用“路由模式”仅在涉及 UI 任务时加载，避免上下文污染。该方案强调以功能完整性与证据为基础，而非强制美学风格，确保 AI 输出具备可维护性与专业度。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.2】Flaminis/Dalaran
items.summary:
* **标题**：【GitHub 黑马 No.2】Dalaran：ROS 2 原生多模态时序数据可视化与观测栈
* **核心摘要**：Dalaran 是一款专为机器人团队设计的 Apache 2.0 开源工具，提供 ROS 2 原生支持，涵盖 LiDAR、相机流及 IMU 等多模态时序数据。其核心能力包括基于 URDF 的高层日志 API、ROS 2 桥接与 rosbag2 回放、REP-103/REP-105 轴约定自动处理，以及针对 nav2 成本地图的语义化渲染。项目采用 Arrow 后端存储，支持 Python、Rust 及 C++ 多语言接入，旨在解决机器人数据可视化中轴约定错误与数据解耦痛点。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.4】retrovaliks/polymarket-btc-5min-trading-bot
items.summary:
* **标题**：GitHub 黑马：Polymarket BTC 5 分钟 AI 交易机器人
* **核心摘要**：Retro Valix 基于 NautilusTrader 构建的 Polymarket BTC 5 分钟交易机器人，采用多信号融合与 ML 边缘过滤策略。项目提供公开版与付费版，公开版支持 BTC 模拟与实盘测试，付费版提供 20 万 + 交易数据训练，宣称胜率 98.8%+。用户可通过 Telegram 或 X 联系合作，支持 BTC、ETH、SOL 等多币种交易。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.6】Samin100/codex-ios-assistant
items.summary:
* **标题**：基于 iMessage 的远程 iOS 控制，Codex 新工具实现跨设备自动化
* **核心摘要**：该项目通过 `iphone` CLI 与 iMessage 私有命令结合，利用 LaunchAgent 绕过沙盒限制，实现 Mac 端对 iPhone 的远程控制。支持读取屏幕、管理闹钟、调用原生应用等 95 项自动化操作，需配合 Cloudflare Tunnel 及 iCloud 同步完成部署。

items.title: 【GitHub昨日黑马No.1】maliubiao/dgx-spark-2-deepseek-flash-0731
items.summary:
* **标题**：DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 双 DGX Spark 集群部署复现指南
* **核心摘要**：项目提供基于 vLLM 与 DSark 镜像的双 DGX Spark 集群部署方案，通过 200GbE QSFP 直连构建高吞吐推理环境。文档涵盖硬件拓扑、NCCL 通信验证、模型下载及系统自启脚本，实测单会话吞吐达 60–70 tok/s，GPU 温度稳定在 70°C 左右，支持长时运行不崩溃。
